prompt: Add retries to fetch in http_client.py. Add two parameters: max_retries=3 and sleep=time.sleep. If transport raises TransientError, wait and try again, up to max_retries retries (so at most max_retries + 1 attempts), waiting 0.5s before the first retry and doubling the wait each time (0.5, 1, 2, ...), using the sleep function. If all attempts fail, raise the last TransientError. Any other exception must propagate immediately without retrying. fetch(url, transport) must keep working as before.
